text: 刺猬取出上回点过泥点的弯木片，正好碰见一颗夹在木片凹弯里的小石子。它先没把石子扔开，拨到苔石上试了试：石子压着哪一头，那一头就不容易翘。你连续四天晚饭后散步，今天在小溪旁记下小树枝转弯的两次观察差异；刺猬于是带着这个小发现去了自己的浅滩。它找到一颗同样扁、却有天然半月凹口的浅灰石，用鼻尖把它推到一根漂停的小枝旁，凹口恰好留出一道水缝。它把石子洗净带回来给你看：不是木片上的新记号，是能压住小枝的一颗小石。收好时，它在半壳内侧让石子靠着弯木片，凹叶里的种子仍在原位。

home: 家仍在苔石边，草垫小窝供休息，壳墙的大叶雨檐挡雨，苔石外沿可走动。半片乳白浅褐斑蛋壳挡风，床边干草保留。凹叶收藏原种子，半壳内侧干草旁放着两端一颗与两颗浅泥点的弯木片，本次新增的浅灰扁石有天然半月凹口，靠弯木片放置；原物件延续，不搬家。

request.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single brought-back object from a fantasy pixel hedgehog's creek. Create exactly ONE small flat light-gray stone with a natural crescent-shaped notch opening from one edge. A rounded squat pebble with subtly asymmetrical worn outline, notch visibly a clean natural concavity, simple two-gray cartoon pixel blocks, a few pale gray facets, compact clear silhouette. Show the object alone, centered and large against a plain opaque warm cream background; no other objects, no pet, no person, no scenery, no grass, no twig, no wooden token, no mud dots, no text, no border, no labels. Three-quarter shallow angle just enough to show it is a flattened stone. This is the specific small stone the pet brought home after trying it beside a twig, not a general scenic illustration. Crisp stepped pixel edges, approachable simplified game-item appearance, no photoreal texture.
